get.description: Return whether the health model exists and its current health state.

get.description: Return the data annotations recorded for an entity, newest first.

parameters.description: The entity to return data annotations for.

parameters.name: startAt
parameters.description: Start of the requested window (UTC); defaults to 24 hours before now when omitted.

parameters.name: endAt
parameters.description: End of the requested window (UTC); defaults to now when omitted.

parameters.name: top
parameters.description: Maximum number of annotations to return; defaults to 100 when omitted.

parameters.name: nextMarker
parameters.description: An opaque string value that identifies the portion of the result set to be returned with the next operation.

get.description: Return the health-state transitions recorded for an entity, newest first.

parameters.name: entityName
parameters.description: The entity to return health-state transitions for.

parameters.name: startAt
parameters.description: Start of the requested window (UTC); defaults to 24 hours before now when omitted.

parameters.name: endAt
parameters.description: End of the requested window (UTC); defaults to now when omitted.

parameters.name: top

parameters.name: nextMarker
parameters.description: An opaque string value that identifies the portion of the result set to be returned with the next operation.

DataAnnotation.description: A data annotation recorded for an entity.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the annotation was created (UTC).

description.description: Description of the annotation; null when none is recorded.

annotationDetails.description: Additional details for the annotation; null when none is recorded.

DataAnnotationsResponse.description: Data annotations recorded for an entity, newest first.

value.description: The data annotations, ordered newest first.

nextLink.description: The full URI to fetch the next page of results; absent when there is no next page.

EntityHealthStateHistoryResponse.description: Health-state periods overlapping the requested window, newest first.

value.description: The health-state periods, ordered newest first.

EntityHealthStatePeriod.description: A contiguous interval during which the entity held a single health state.

healthState.description: Health state held during this period — typically one of Unknown, Healthy, Degraded, or Unhealthy. The value as recorded; an open string, not a closed enum.

startAt.description:
When this state became active (UTC). Omitted when the state was already active at the
earliest point observable from retained data — i.e. its true start is older than the
~30-day data-retention window, predates the entity's first recorded transition, or lies
beyond the result cap.

endAt.description:
When the entity transitioned away from this state (UTC). Omitted when the state is still
active now (no later transition recorded).

EntityTransitionHistoryResponse.description: Health-state transitions overlapping the requested window, newest first.

value.description: The health-state transitions, ordered newest first.

nextLink.description: The full URI to fetch the next page of results; absent when there is no next page.

previousState.description: Previous health state before the transition

newState.description: New health state after the transition

ModelNotFoundResponse.description: Returned when the requested health model does not exist.

body.description: Echoed health-model status; reports that the requested health model does not exist.

QueryEchoResponse.description: Health state of the requested health model, echoed by data-plane operations.

healthModelExists.description: True when a health model exists for the requested id.

healthModelState.description: Health state of the health model; omitted when the health model does not exist.

SignalDataPointHistoryResponse.description: Signal data points recorded for an entity's signal, newest first.

value.description: The signal data points, ordered newest first.

nextLink.description: The full URI to fetch the next page of results; absent when there is no next page.

SignalHistoryDataPoint.description: A single recorded signal data point.

occurredAt.description: Timestamp when the data point occurred (UTC).

value.description: Value of the signal at this point; null when the signal has no numeric value at this point.

healthState.description: Health state of the signal at this point.

additionalContext.description: Additional context for this data point; null when none is recorded.

entityName.description: Entity resource name; matches the control-plane proxy-resource naming contract.

signalName.description: Signal resource name; matches the control-plane proxy-resource naming contract.

string4096.description: String with max length validation of 4096 characters
